name: Trailblazer Elation
description:
A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.
{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

skills.name: Make Some Noise
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Let the Storm Rage On
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains #2[i] point(s) of "Certified Banger."
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies and gains "Certified Banger."

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
skills.desc:
Gains #6[i] Punchline point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s), and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on them.
If the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain #4[i] point(s) of "Certified Banger" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of #5[i] Punchline point(s). If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target.
If the target does not have Elation Skill, their action advances by #3[i]%.
skills.simpleDesc: Gains Punchline. Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally, and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on that target. If the target has Elation Skill, the target additionally gains "Certified Banger" and immediately uses their Elation Skill. Otherwise, their action advances.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

extra.name: Crowd Control debuff
extra.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Action Advance
extra.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: That Smile Hits Different
skills.desc:
After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of #1[i] Energy and gains #2[i] Punchline point(s).
When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals #3[i]% Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "Certified Banger" value among all allies.
skills.simpleDesc:
After using an attack, regenerates Energy and gains Punchline.
When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals minor Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: We Are So Back!
skills.desc:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by #1[i]%.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by #3[i]%.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for #5[i] turn(s).
skills.simpleDesc: After using Technique, increases all allies' Elation when entering the next battle.

skills.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
skills.desc: Deals #1[i] instances of DMG, with each instance dealing #2[i]% Lightning Elation DMG to one random enemy. At last, deals #3[i]% Lightning Elation DMG, which is split evenly among all enemies.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals multiple instances of DMG, with each instance dealing minor Lightning Elation DMG to one random enemy. At last, deals Lightning Elation DMG that is split evenly among all enemies.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

eidolons.name: Believe In the Light
eidolons.desc: After using Skill, the next Ultimate increases the amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" gained by ally targets by <nobr>2</nobr>. This effect can stack up to <nobr>3</nobr> time(s).

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

eidolons.name: History in the Making...
eidolons.desc: Ultimate additionally increases the Elation of one designated ally by <nobr>12%</nobr>, lasting for <nobr>2</nobr> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Into the Spotlight
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Save the World. Just Because.
eidolons.desc: When using Elation Skill, increases the DMG taken by enemy targets by <nobr>10%</nobr>, lasting for <nobr>2</nobr> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Love & Courage: Always in Style
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>10</nobr>.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: The Cosmic Legend Cometh!
eidolons.desc: When using Elation Skill, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by <nobr>100%</nobr> for <nobr>3</nobr> turns.

embedBonusSkill.name: On Cloud Nine
embedBonusSkill.desc: For every <nobr>200</nobr> point(s) of Trailblazer's ATK that exceeds <nobr>1000</nobr>, increases this unit's Elation stat by <nobr>#3[f1]%</nobr>, up to a maximum increase of <nobr>#4[f1]%</nobr>.

embedBonusSkill.name: Screw It, We Ball
embedBonusSkill.desc: Increases this unit's CRIT Rate by <nobr>15%</nobr>. After using Ultimate, recovers <nobr>1</nobr> Skill Point(s) for the team.

embedBonusSkill.name: Aha, Sic 'Em!
embedBonusSkill.desc: After an ally target uses Elation Skill, Trailblazer additionally gains <nobr>2</nobr> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" the next time they use their Skill.
